ui_bugs.issue: Footer at /app/frontend/app/past-questions/[id].tsx (styles.footer, lines 198-202) uses position:'absolute', bottom:0 with only padding: spacing.md. It imports useSafeAreaInsets() (line 21) but only applies insets.bottom to ScrollView paddingBottom (line 85), not to the footer container itself. On real devices Previous / Discuss with AI / Next buttons will be overlapped by the Android 3-button/gesture bar or iOS home indicator. Wrap footer in SafeAreaView edges=['bottom'] or set paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, spacing.md).

rca_of_issue: MCQ footer overlap: styles.footer uses position:'absolute', bottom:0 with padding: spacing.md only. useSafeAreaInsets() is called but insets.bottom is only used for ScrollView paddingBottom, not for the footer container. Repro on device: open MCQ paper → footer buttons sit inside the system gesture bar area. Fix: replace <View style={styles.footer}> with <SafeAreaView edges={['bottom']} style={styles.footer}> OR add style={[styles.footer, {paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, spacing.md)}]}.
